key_points: Q3 2026 earnings beat consensus adjusted EPS by $0.07 with record sales, profit and EPS on higher Americas pricing and volumes.
Raises Q4 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to 5-7% growth; however, 2026 guidance trails consensus per ChartMill.
Multiple analysts lift price targets and maintain Buy ratings (KeyBanc raises PT; Bernstein reaffirms Buy); new institutional buying noted.
Stock rose ~3% after the earnings beat despite reported charges of ~$425M that pressured headline earnings.
Electronics demand expansion and restructuring actions support outlook near-term, though guarded guidance tempers enthusiasm.
